Austria / Lech, Oberlech and St. Christoph

pepper-collection

A collection of private chalets and apartments in Lech, Oberlech and St. Christoph on the Arlberg, for families and friends. Some sit right on the slopes; The Barn & Chalet Mimi come with a butler and a private chef.

Plan a stay hereAbout Lech am Arlberg
01 / 05

In short

What to know.

  • Chalet Mimi in Oberlech: ski-in and ski-out in winter, for up to 14 guests, with a butler and a private chef
  • The Barn in Oberlech: 1,000 m², with a 24/7 butler and a private chef
  • Skyfall in St. Christoph: four apartments; the two largest combine into one residence for up to 21 guests
  • Arla Luxury Home on the Schlegelkopf slope, for groups of 2 to 10

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For families and groups who want a private house on the Arlberg, with the service of a hotel when they want it.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. Each house is provided by pepper-collection, under its terms.

The houses

Chalets and apartments.

01 / 10

Chalet · Oberlech

Chalet Mimi

  • 14 guests
  • 6 bedrooms
  • 830 m²
  • Ski-in/ski-out
  • Indoor pool
  • Sauna
  • Hot tub
  • Butler and private chef

Chalet Mimi in Oberlech comes with a 24/7 butler, an in-house chef, a wine cellar and a heated outdoor hot tub facing the mountains. Besides the master suite, it has three double rooms, two of them with a connected bunk room for children. The spa has a 14 m indoor pool with a cinema screen, a bio sauna and a steam bath.

Enquire about this chalet: Chalet Mimi
01 / 10

Chalet · Oberlech

The Barn

  • 14 guests
  • 7 bedrooms
  • 7 bathrooms
  • about 1,000 m²
  • Ski-in/ski-out
  • Indoor pool
  • Sauna
  • Butler and private chef
  • Gym

The Barn in Oberlech is designed in a "northern chic meets alpine luxury" style and comes with a 24/7 butler and a private chef. Its private spa has a 14 m indoor pool, a sauna, a steam room, a gym and a treatment room. It also has a wine cellar and an entertainment room with a bar that can be used as a cinema, a games room or for private events.

Enquire about this chalet: The Barn
01 / 10

Chalet · Lech centre

The Falcon

  • 8 guests
  • 4 bedrooms
  • 4 bathrooms
  • 450 m²
  • Close to the Schlosskopf lift
  • Sauna
  • Hot tub
  • Gym
  • Pets welcome

The Falcon lies close to the centre of Lech, a stone's throw from the Schlosskopf chairlift, with panoramic views over the village and the surrounding mountains. It has four individually designed bedrooms, a wine cellar with a tasting area, and a spa with a hot tub and a bio sauna. Pets are welcome.

Enquire about this chalet: The Falcon
01 / 10

Chalet · Lech centre

Arla Luxury Home

  • 2–10 guests
  • 5 bedrooms
  • Direct access to the slopes
  • Sauna
  • Gym
  • Games room

Arla Luxury Home is a chalet a few minutes' walk from the centre of Lech, with views of the Omeshorn. Its three units can be taken separately or together, for two to ten guests. Guests also have access to the spa and the 23-metre pool of the neighbouring Hotel Aurelio.

Enquire about this chalet: Arla Luxury Home
01 / 10

Chalet · Lech

Chalet Toda

  • 6 guests
  • 3 bedrooms
  • 2 bathrooms
  • 245 m²
  • A short walk to the lifts
  • Sauna
  • Pets welcome

Chalet Toda is a traditional alpine chalet in a quiet yet central spot in Lech, a short walk from the Rüfikopf and Schlegelkopf lifts. The 18th-century Stube seats six at its dining table, every bedroom has a balcony with mountain views, and there is a private sauna. Pets are welcome.

Enquire about this chalet: Chalet Toda
01 / 10

Chalet and apartments · St. Christoph

Skyfall

  • about 800 m²
  • Sauna
  • Private lifts between floors

In the small hamlet of St. Christoph, Skyfall has four apartments of 116 to 275 m² across four floors. The two largest can be combined through private lifts into one 550 m² residence for up to 21 guests. There are saunas, freestanding bathtubs and kitchens designed by David Linley.

Enquire about this chalet: Skyfall
01 / 08

Apartment · Omesberg, Lech

ULA Signature

  • 24 guests
  • 12 bedrooms
  • Indoor pool
  • Sauna
  • Hot tub

ULA Signature is an apartment house in the quiet Omesberg area, about five minutes' walk from the centre of Lech. Its six suites and apartments, of about 50 to 150 m², can be taken separately, combined or as a whole house, and several have their own hot tub. The house has a restaurant and a spa with an indoor pool, a sauna and a steam bath. The pictures are renderings.

Enquire about this apartment: ULA Signature
01 / 10

Apartment · Omesberg, Lech

ULA Easy Stay

  • About 5 min walk to the lifts
  • Sauna

ULA Easy Stay is a lovingly renovated house in the quiet Omesberg area, about five minutes' walk from the centre of Lech and the lifts. Each of its six apartments has a living area, a kitchen and a private balcony with mountain views, and the whole house can also be taken as one. Guests share a sauna and an infrared cabin.

Enquire about this apartment: ULA Easy Stay
